events.title: Theodore Roosevelt's Birthday Celebration
events.description:
Join us on Saturday, October 24th and Sunday, October 25th to celebrate Theodore Roosevelt’s 168th birthday! If you come to the Birthplace dressed as TR on either day, you will receive a small “birthday present” to take home! There will also be free crafts, a photo op station, and a children’s storytime held at 10:15 AM and 1:00 PM on both days!

Theodore Roosevelt Bithplace is at 28 East 20th Street, New York, NY 10003. The site is open from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Free first-come, first-served house tours are available at 11:00, 12:00, 2:00, and 3:00. Space for these tours is limited. Questions? Please email thrb_info@nps.gov or visit www.nps.gov/thrb.
